rule: judged once it has 50+ counted (buyable, settled) copies in 30+ different events. Score = 80 + 2.5 x expected profit per copy (c/contract after fees): every trader starts at what copying earns on average (-3.5c now) and only its own counted copies move it, one credit per event, our real-money results counting double. Copied at 80+ (expected profit above 0) while its last 50 copies average better than -leeway (5c, +up to 5c for a high score); paused below that, back when it recovers. Size: 90+ = 2, 95+ (300 copies) = 3, only after 20+ real copies in profit
